medgemma:4b.answer:
The standard dose of intravenous alteplase (tPA) for acute ischemic stroke is 0.9 mg/kg, with a maximum dose of 90 mg. The administration involves a bolus of 10% of the total dose given over 1 minute, followed by the remaining 90% infused slowly over 60 minutes. Eligibility criteria include symptom onset within 4.5 hours and absence of contraindications such as recent surgery, active bleeding, elevated INR (>1.7), low platelet count (<100k), or hypoglycemia (<50). Blood pressure must be controlled at <185/110 mmHg before tPA administration and maintained below <180/105 mmHg during the first 24 hours post-administration.

<details><cited_sources>[EXT-STROKE-001]</cited_sources></details>
